notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAupdatesSent value. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application class/member names. Three receive-order Update Attribute Values invocations (including two updates to the same object) are checked directly, followed by two additional invocations checked directly and through HLAsetTiming periodic reporting. Each invocation is correlated with one ordinary reflection callback. The FOM uses no DDM regions, and the test makes no DDM-accounting claim. No provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics are used.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM value requests, object-class publication/subscription, object registration and receive-order attribute updates, HLAsetTiming control, with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
